app.about_text:
EL Measurement Equipment Control v{version}

Features: Live View, manual exposure and Gain, continuous auto exposure, capture after one-shot auto exposure, TIFF/PNG/JPEG output, VISA SMU discovery and safe connection, manual CV/CC, and Recipe editing and validation.

SMU support: Keysight B2900 series (manual output requires hardware safety verification)
Recipe: all-channel polarity → Shared Dark → per-channel Dark I–V → J → Gain → Exposure → Repeat
Multi-channel EL Matrix automation, live progress, and safe stop
Camera interface: RisingCam SDK 57.27250.20241216

errors.cause.not_selected: No device has been selected for this operation.
errors.cause.connection: The device connection was interrupted, USB/VISA communication failed, or a cable is loose.
errors.cause.device_busy: The device is busy with another operation or application.
errors.cause.timeout: The device did not respond or provide new data within the allowed time.
errors.cause.configuration: The configuration is invalid, incomplete, or incompatible with this version.
errors.cause.io: The file or settings location cannot be read or written.
errors.cause.disk: Disk space is insufficient, the path is invalid, or permission was denied.
errors.cause.hardware_state: The hardware state differs from the expected state or cannot be confirmed reliably.
errors.cause.workflow: A workflow prerequisite or safety handover has not completed.
errors.cause.compliance: The setpoint or sample condition triggered an SMU compliance limit.
errors.cause.internal: The software encountered an unexpected internal exception.
errors.solution.select_camera: Select a camera in the left camera list and try again.
errors.solution.select_smu: Select an instrument in the left SMU list and try again.
errors.solution.check_connection: Check USB/VISA cables, device power, and the operating system device status.
errors.solution.reconnect: Reconnect the device and confirm its state before continuing.
errors.solution.retry: Confirm the prerequisites, then retry the operation.
errors.solution.review_settings: Review the settings and correct the indicated fields.
errors.solution.check_permissions: Confirm that the location exists and the current user has read/write permission.
errors.solution.verify_path: Choose a writable output folder and avoid invalid file names.
errors.solution.check_disk: Check available disk space and file-system health.
errors.solution.inspect_hardware: Inspect the device panel and wiring directly and confirm that the hardware is safe.
errors.solution.safe_shutdown: Run safe shutdown and confirm that all outputs and relays are off before continuing.
errors.solution.review_recipe: Review the Recipe and version, then correct validation errors before saving or loading.
errors.solution.smu_panel_off: Check the SMU front-panel OUTPUT indicator. If it is still on, turn it off manually from the panel.
errors.solution.review_setpoint: Confirm that the setpoint, compliance, and sample area are appropriate.
errors.solution.inspect_sample: Check sample wiring, polarity, and possible shorts.
errors.solution.copy_diagnostics: Copy the diagnostics and retain the steps that led to the problem.
errors.solution.contact_support: If the problem happens again, provide the diagnostics to the software maintainer.
errors.CAM-101.title: No Camera Selected
errors.CAM-101.message: No selected camera is available for this operation.
errors.CAM-201.title: Camera Connection Failed
errors.CAM-201.message: The software could not establish or maintain a reliable camera connection.
errors.CAM-202.title: Camera Acquisition Failed
errors.CAM-202.message: The camera did not provide a valid image for this operation.
errors.CAM-203.title: Camera Acquisition Timed Out
errors.CAM-203.message: No new camera image arrived within the allowed time, so the operation stopped waiting.
errors.CFG-101.title: Settings Read/Write Failed
errors.CFG-101.message: The settings could not be loaded or saved reliably; existing data is preserved where possible.
errors.FILE-201.title: File Save Failed
errors.FILE-201.message: The measurement or image file could not be written completely to the selected location.
errors.HW-001.title: Hardware Safety State Cannot Be Confirmed
errors.HW-001.message: The system cannot confirm that all hardware is safe, so subsequent operations have stopped.
errors.MEAS-101.title: Measurement Preflight Failed
errors.MEAS-101.message: The measurement has not started because one or more required conditions failed.
errors.MEAS-201.title: Measurement Workflow Failed
errors.MEAS-201.message: The measurement stopped. Successfully written data is retained and the existing safety cleanup runs.
errors.REC-101.title: Recipe Load Failed
errors.REC-101.message: The Recipe could not be read reliably; the original file will not be overwritten.
errors.REC-201.title: Recipe Save Failed
errors.REC-201.message: The Recipe changes could not be saved; the existing Recipe is retained.
errors.REL-101.title: Relay Not Connected
errors.REL-101.message: USBRelay8 is not currently available for Relay operations.
errors.REL-102.title: Relay Safety Routing Cannot Be Confirmed
errors.REL-102.message: The system cannot confirm that Relay routing is safely off, so SMU output operations are blocked.
errors.REL-203.title: Relay Operation Failed
errors.REL-203.message: The Relay did not complete the command or its readback did not match the expected state.
errors.SMU-101.title: No SMU Selected
errors.SMU-101.message: No selected SMU is available for this operation.
errors.SMU-201.title: SMU Operation Failed
errors.SMU-201.message: The SMU did not complete the command. The operation stopped and remains fail-closed.
errors.SMU-203.title: Unable to Confirm SMU Output OFF
errors.SMU-203.message: The software attempted to turn the SMU output off but could not confirm the OUTPUT OFF state from the instrument. Subsequent operations stopped to avoid leaving the sample energized.
errors.SMU-204.title: SMU Compliance Active
errors.SMU-204.message: The SMU reached its configured compliance limit, so the output may not have reached the requested setpoint.
errors.SMU-205.title: Unexpected SMU Output Detected
errors.SMU-205.message: The SMU was read back as OUTPUT ON in a state where output is not allowed. Normal output is blocked and safety handling is required.
errors.SYS-001.title: Unexpected Internal Error
errors.SYS-001.message: The software encountered an unexpected problem and could not complete the operation. Technical exception details were recorded.
